name: 提现财务审批
description: 兼职人员提交提现后，由有提现审核权限的财务人员审批
bpmnXml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<definitions xmlns="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:flowable="http://flowable.org/bpmn"
 xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI" xmlns:omgdc="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DC"
 xmlns:omgdi="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DI" targetNamespace="https://zsjos.com/bpm">
 <process id="zsjos_partner_withdrawal" name="提现财务审批" isExecutable="true">
  <startEvent id="StartEvent"/><sequenceFlow id="flow1" sourceRef="StartEvent" targetRef="financeReview"/>
  <userTask id="financeReview" name="财务审批" flowable:assignee="${assignee}">
   <extensionElements>
    <flowable:candidateStrategy>35</flowable:candidateStrategy>
    <flowable:approveType>1</flowable:approveType>
    <flowable:approveMethod>3</flowable:approveMethod>
    <flowable:reasonRequire>true</flowable:reasonRequire>
   </extensionElements>
   <multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics isSequential="false" flowable:collection="${coll_userList}" flowable:elementVariable="assignee">
    <completionCondition xsi:type="tFormalExpression"><![CDATA[${nrOfCompletedInstances > 0}]]></completionCondition>
   </multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics>
  </userTask>
  <sequenceFlow id="flow2" sourceRef="financeReview" targetRef="EndEvent"/><endEvent id="EndEvent"/>
 </process>
 <bpmndi:BPMNDiagram id="Diagram"><bpmndi:BPMNPlane id="Plane" bpmnElement="zsjos_partner_withdrawal">
  <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="s1" bpmnElement="StartEvent"><omgdc:Bounds x="100" y="140" width="36" height="36"/></bpmndi:BPMNShape>
  <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="s2" bpmnElement="financeReview"><omgdc:Bounds x="230" y="110" width="180" height="96"/></bpmndi:BPMNShape>
  <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="s3" bpmnElement="EndEvent"><omgdc:Bounds x="510" y="140" width="36" height="36"/></bpmndi:BPMNShape>
  <bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="e1" bpmnElement="flow1"><omgdi:waypoint x="136" y="158"/><omgdi:waypoint x="230" y="158"/></bpmndi:BPMNEdge>
  <bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="e2" bpmnElement="flow2"><omgdi:waypoint x="410" y="158"/><omgdi:waypoint x="510" y="158"/></bpmndi:BPMNEdge>
 </bpmndi:BPMNPlane></bpmndi:BPMNDiagram>
</definitions>
